title: Madrid Cluster 4 Complete — Mora Joins Night 8; 512,000+ Fans Through Eight Nights
detail: Bad Bunny completes Cluster 4 (Nights 7–8, June 10–11) of his 10-night Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid. Night 7 (June 10) featured no musical guest — 'Un Verano Sin Ti' was the exclusive song — with footballers Alexia Putellas and Kika Nazareth among the 64,000 in attendance. Night 8 (June 11) brought out Puerto Rican artist Mora to perform their 2023 collaboration alongside a run of his own biggest tracks. Eight of ten sold-out nights are now complete, with cumulative attendance reaching approximately 512,000 fans. One cluster remains: Cluster 5 (June 14–15), the residency's closing nights.
